```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(ggdag)
```

# Testing drivers

Proposal: overproductivity at different time steps (of rnow: 20 years after logging)

```{r}
dag_data <- dagify(
  prod ~ agb + div + dsi + rad + tor + int,
  agb ~ div + tor + rad + dsi,
  div ~ tor + rad + dsi,
  vpd ~ prc + rad,
  prc ~ cloud,
  rad ~ cloud,
  dsi ~ prc + vpd,
  tor ~ slope + wind
) |>
  tidy_dagitty(layout = "stress") |>
  mutate(
    node_shape = ifelse(name == "prod", "square", "circle"),
    type = case_when(
      name == "prod" ~ "outcome",
      name %in% c("agb", "div", "tor") ~ "endogeneous",
      name %in% c("twi", "slope") ~ "topography",
      name %in% c("int") ~ "logging",
      name %in% c("cloud", "wind", "rad", "prc", "vpd", "dsi")
      ~ "climate"
    )
  )
ggplot(dag_data, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend)) +
  geom_dag_edges() +
  geom_dag_node(aes(col = type, shape = node_shape)) +
  geom_dag_text() +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("circle" = 19, "square" = 15)) +
  guides(shape = "none") +
  theme_dag()
```

- prod: overproductivity (outcome variable)
- int: logging intensity
- agb: pre-logging aboveground biomass of the plot
- div: pre-logging species diversity of the plot
- dsi: dry season intensity
- rad: solar radiation (light availability)
- cloud: cloud cover
- vpd: water vapour pressure deficit
- prc: annual precipitation
- pvar: precipitation variability
- wind: maximum wind speed
- tor: pre-logging turnover rate ( = stem recruitment / number of stems)
<!-- - twi: topographic wetness index -->
- slope: average slope in the plot


```{r}
sites <- read.csv("data/derived_data/sites_to_keep.csv") |>
  filter(ncensus >= 10)
vars <- c("ba", "agb", "diversity_q1_gen", "nstem", "nstem_recr")
plot_info <- read.csv("data/raw_data/bioforest-plot-information.csv") |>
  rename_with(tolower) |>
  inner_join(read.csv("data/raw_data/plot_correspondance.csv")) |>
  select(site, new_plot, treatment, year_of_harvest) |>
  rename(plot = new_plot) |>
  unique()
mean0 <- function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
endo_variables <- read.csv("data/derived_data/aggregated_data_v10.csv") |>
  rename_with(tolower) |>
  filter(variable %in% vars & site %in% sites$Site) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "variable") |>
  mutate(tor = nstem_recr / nstem) |>
  rename(div = diversity_q1_gen) |>
  select(-contains("nstem")) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c("ba", "agb", "div", "tor"), values_drop_na = TRUE) |>
  inner_join(plot_info) |>
  group_by(site, name) |>
  mutate(eq_s = mean(value[treatment == "Control"])) |>
  group_by(site, plot, treatment, name, eq_s) |>
  filter(treatment == "Logging") |>
  summarise(
    eq_p = mean(value[year < year_of_harvest]),
    log_p = value[which.min(value[year > year_of_harvest])]
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(values_from = contains("_"), names_glue = "{name}_{.value}") |>
  ## use site-level BA for plots without pre-logging inventories
  mutate(int = ifelse(is.na(ba_eq_p),
    (ba_eq_s - ba_log_p) / ba_eq_s,
    (ba_eq_p - ba_log_p) / ba_eq_p
  )) |>
  select(site, plot, int, contains("eq") & !contains("ba"))

params <- read.csv("data/derived_data/params_flux_all.csv") |>
  rename_with(tolower) |>
  rename(plot = plot_new) |>
  inner_join(endo_variables) |>
  filter(variable == "stpp_20") |>
  inner_join(readr::read_tsv("data/raw_data/environment.tsv"))
```

```{r}
graph_effect <- function(data, var, coefs, label = var) {
  if (grepl("eq_p", var)) {
    data <- data |> mutate(
      pre_logging = !is.na(get(var)),
      var = coalesce(get(var), get(gsub("_p", "_s", var)))
    )
  } else {
    data <- data |> mutate(var = get(var), pre_logging = is.na(div_eq_p))
  }
  data |>
    mutate(var = as.vector(scale(var))) |>
    ggplot(aes(var, mean, shape = pre_logging)) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(col = site, ymin = q5, ymax = q95)) +
    geom_function(fun = function(x) exp(coefs[1] + coefs[2] * x), lty = 2) +
    labs(x = label, y = "Predicted overproductivity duration [yr]") +
    theme_classic()
}
```

### Testing for the effect of logging intensity


```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7
ggdag_adjustment_set(dag_data,
  exposure = "int",
  outcome = "prod",
  effect = "direct",
  node_size = 20
) +
  theme_dag()
```

```{r}
glmint <- params |>
  mutate(int = as.vector(scale(int))) |>
  glm(mean ~ int, family = gaussian(link = "log"), data = _)
summary(glmint)
```

```{r}
graph_effect(params, "int", glmint$coefficients, "Logging intensity (scaled)")
```

### Testing for the effect of pre-logging diversity


```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7
ggdag_adjustment_set(dag_data,
  exposure = "div",
  outcome = "prod",
  effect = "direct",
  node_size = 20
) +
  theme_dag()
```

With sites that have pre-logging inventories: 

```{r}
#| include: true
params |>
  filter(!is.na(div_eq_p)) |>
  mutate(across(contains("eq_p") | contains("dsi"), ~ as.vector(scale(.x)))) |>
  glm(mean ~ div_eq_p + agb_eq_p + tor_eq_p + dsi,
    family = gaussian(link = "log"), data = _
  ) |>
  summary()
```

With all sites (using control plots for pre-logging conditions in sites where there is no pre-logging inventory): 

```{r}
#| include: true
glmreg <- params |>
  mutate(
    div_eq_p = coalesce(div_eq_p, div_eq_s),
    agb_eq_p = coalesce(agb_eq_p, agb_eq_s),
    tor_eq_p = coalesce(tor_eq_p, tor_eq_s)
  ) |>
  mutate(across(contains("eq_p") | contains("dsi"), ~ as.vector(scale(.x)))) |>
  glm(mean ~ div_eq_p + agb_eq_p + tor_eq_p + dsi,
    family = gaussian(link = "log"), data = _
  )
summary(glmreg)
```


```{r}
graph_effect(
  params, "div_eq_p", glmreg$coefficients[c(1, 2)],
  "Scaled pre-logging Shannon index (genus level)"
)
```
